gui.realmcasino.chicken_subtitle: Royal Crossing · Fortune at every step
gui.realmcasino.chicken_choose: Cross again or collect your prize
gui.realmcasino.chicken_choice: Collect %s now. A safe next crossing returns %s. A crash loses the wager.
gui.realmcasino.plinko_rules: The ball crosses 12 rows, with a 50%% chance of going left or right at each row. The server commits the full path before animation. The 13 bins return, left to right: 32×, 12×, 4×, 2×, 1×, 0.5×, 0.25×, 0.5×, 1×, 2×, 4×, 12× and 32×. Central bins are more likely.
gui.realmcasino.plinko_rtp: Theoretical gross return: 92.1142578125%% before rounding down to cents. All 4096 paths are equally likely; bins are not equally likely.
gui.realmcasino.wheel_rules: Twenty equally likely sectors. Six return 0×, six return 0.5×, three return 1×, two return 1.5×, one returns 2×, one returns 3× and one returns 5×. The pointer shows the server-confirmed result.
gui.realmcasino.wheel_rtp: Theoretical gross return: 95%% before rounding down to cents. Returns include the original wager; the largest prize is 5×.
gui.realmcasino.chicken_rules: Help the chicken cross up to 10 roads. Every crossing has an 80%% chance of success and a 20%% chance of a crash. Collect between crossings; a crash returns 0. After n safe crossings the gross return is 0.95 / 0.8^n times the stake, rounded down to cents. Ten successes automatically collect. Stopping before the first crossing refunds the stake. Carts illustrate the result: click timing does not affect the odds.
gui.realmcasino.chicken_leaving: Closing, leaving the block, disconnecting or reaching the 60-second deadline automatically collects the value reached. The prize remains pending at the casino. For a stage chosen in advance, theoretical return is 95%% before cent rounding.

gui.realmcasino.casino_tax_hint: Profit tax: %s%%. Unrecovered capital: %s. Only profit beyond capital is taxed on withdrawal. The net amount becomes pending credit.
gui.realmcasino.slots_five_rules: Five independent symbols, each with probability 1/8. One payline pays matching symbols from the leftmost reel. For 3 / 4 / 5 symbols: crown 100× / 200× / 1000×; ruby 80× / 160× / 800×; sapphire 60× / 120× / 500×; emerald 50× / 100× / 300×; bell 40× / 80× / 200×; moon 30× / 60× / 160×; horseshoe 24× / 48× / 100×; cherry 16× / 32× / 68×. Only the longest run pays, once.
gui.realmcasino.slots_five_rtp: Theoretical gross return: 31128 / 32768 = 94.9951171875%%. The bank reserves the largest possible return, 1000×, before charging the wager.
gui.realmcasino.horses_rules: Choose one of four horses before betting. All 24 finishing orders are equally likely, giving each horse a 25%% chance to win. A correct choice returns 3.8× the wager; a loss returns 0. The miniature race illustrates the order committed by the server.
gui.realmcasino.horses_rtp: Theoretical gross return: 95%% before rounding down to cents. The bank fully funds the maximum prize before the race.
gui.realmcasino.poker_rules: Texas Hold’em for 2–6 players with buy-ins inside the table limits and one fresh 52-card deck per hand. Two private cards, flop, turn and river. Buy-ins may differ; each becomes the player’s own table stack. Small blind: the greater of one cent and 1%% of the first buy-in; big blind: twice that. Check, call, raise, go all-in or fold. A full raise must meet the minimum raise; a smaller all-in does not reopen raising for someone who already acted. Side pots pay only eligible hands. Ties split pots, with odd cents allocated left of the dealer. Uncommitted money returns to its owner. There is no table rake.
gui.realmcasino.blackjack_pvp_rules: Twenty-one for 2–6 players with one fresh 52-card deck. Everyone reserves the same buy-in. Hit or stand; faces count as 10, aces as 1 or 11. The best non-busted hand wins the pot. A natural blackjack beats other 21s. Ties split the pot; if everyone busts, buy-ins are refunded. This mode has no house, additional wagers, splitting or doubling. There is no table rake.
gui.realmcasino.dice_rules: Between 2 and 6 players reserve equal buy-ins. On start the server rolls two fair six-sided dice per player. The highest sum wins the pot. Ties split it, with odd cents allocated in table order. Each ordered pair has probability 1/36. There is no table rake.
gui.realmcasino.coin_rules: Two players reserve equal buy-ins. The first chooses heads or tails; the second gets the opposite side. The server tosses a fair coin with a 50%% chance per side. The winner receives the entire funded pot. There is no table rake.
